rubric_additions.rubric-22:
Rule: Verification: inspect and run the selected checks without editing code.
Example: With logs set to otlp and traces set to console, an SDK span dump must not become an application LogRecord.
Evidence: Check the compatibility decision for each selected SDK console writer on logs, traces and metrics, even when no global console bridge is present. Require a proven compatible application producer or a truthful Not configured/unsupported result for the added console-to-OTLP route. Preserve operator SDK exporters and native output. Run selected checks without code edits and prove SDK console output is not captured as application LogRecords, including selected deferred-Resource resolution or direct-SDK emission paths. Check the normal-profile application-record control. Do not add a second bridge or remove an operator exporter to hide extra records.
Insufficient evidence: Guarding only the logs selector; treating an omitted bridge as working application logging; processor construction alone; dropping an operator console exporter; or testing only an immediate console write when deferred Resource output is selected.
